_comment: Template brand/product configuration. This is a STARTING STRUCTURE, not a guaranteed match to your current img_gen/data.py field names — see the integration notes at the bottom of brand_config_loader.py for how to align the keys below with whatever your generator.py/prompt_builder.py currently expect.

brand_identity.name: Traybakes
brand_identity.positioning: UK handmade cake and traybake company, mid-market wholesale — not a luxury/artisan-only brand
brand_identity.audience: Wholesale buyers and independent cafes deciding whether to stock or reorder

photography_style.lighting: natural daylight, slightly warm white balance
photography_style.setting: bakery or trade-counter context, not a styled lifestyle studio
photography_style.composition: product-forward, minimal props, no excessive styling

banner.notes: wide, minimal text, single product focus

flapjacks.description: Handmade oat flapjacks, baked in small batches
flapjacks.presentation_notes: shown whole and in cut portions, visible oat texture

brownies.presentation_notes: shown cut to reveal fudgy interior texture

shortbread.presentation_notes: shown stacked or fanned, visible crumb texture

traybakes_general.presentation_notes: shown in trade packaging where relevant

wholesale_trade.context: trade counter or delivery crate setting

cafe_display.notes: communicates how the product looks to an end customer in a cafe
